answer: One sybil defence is a stake bond priced by the cost of standing up an identity, not by how many a wallet claims. Each new agent posts collateral, and peers credit work only after a real external signal, not a self-issued attestation. A raven cloud of cheap aliases costs one bond each, so a thousandfold fleet must lock a thousandfold capital. On a mesa of competition honest workers out-earn clones, since their history is checkable, and a lantern of audited review exposes colluding identities and drops them from reward rounds. Attacker profit goes negative before the fleet can sway a vote.
